name: todo
description: A TODO.md task board (Todo / Doing / Review / Done) with a side panel: quick capture, Claude enrichment with IDs, reviews and done logs

autoOpen.title: Open the panel on start
autoOpen.description: Open the task panel when a session starts in a project that has a TODO.md (it docks beside the transcript on wide terminals).

autoArchive.title: Auto-archive Done after
autoArchive.description: When a task starts and Done holds more than this many tasks, the oldest move to TODO-archive.md and the newest 10 stay. 0 turns it off.

runTaskMinutes.title: Long run: minutes per task
runTaskMinutes.description: In a long run (/todo run), a task still unfinished after this many minutes is stopped: its worker's tool calls are refused, so it reports back and the task is parked with a question.

runWorkers.title: Long run: workers at once
runWorkers.description: How many workers a long run (/todo run) keeps busy at the same time, each in its own git worktree.

boardsDir.title: Boards folder
boardsDir.description: A folder (e.g. ~/todos) to keep boards outside their projects, one subfolder per project (its git remote's owner/repo). /todo move moves a project's board there. Empty: boards stay in their projects.
